Aegis End-to-End Autonomous Red-Teaming Architecture

Long image

A

Answer

Aegis executes an autonomous, bounded red-teaming assessment across seven specialized agent layers, orchestrating the scan lifecycle from browser calibration to executive PDF reporting.

  1. Deterministic Python state machines govern scan lifecycle states, attempt budgets, and risk scoring without LLM routing.1
  2. A single Qwen3-4B model on GPU VRAM runs sequentially for attack mutations, site classification, rubric judging, and narrative reporting.2
  3. A dedicated Llama-Guard-3-1B model on host CPU triages turns in sub-100ms before heavy rubric judging.
  4. A four-tier evaluation engine combines zero-millisecond deterministic checks with deep LLM rubric scoring to eliminate false positives.

1

How does the end-to-end scanning lifecycle flow?

Diagram structure
  • Calibration Engine calib
  • Recon Agent recon
  • Test Planner plan
  • Orchestrator Engine orch
  • Attack Agent attack
  • Playwright Driver connector
  • Evaluation Agent eval
  • Risk Engine risk
  • Reporting Agent report
  • AI Assistant assist
  • attack → connector · test prompt
  • calib → recon · target URL
  • connector → eval · turn record
  • eval → risk · findings
  • orch → attack · prompt id
  • plan → orch · test plan
  • recon → plan · target profile
  • report → assist · final report
  • risk → report · risk grade
  1. Target Calibration ↗

    User specifies application URL and calibrates chat input and send selectors.

  2. Pre-Scan Reconnaissance ↗

    Inspects HTTP headers, matches YAML stack signatures, and executes benign probes.

  3. Deterministic Test Planning ↗

    Maps profile evidence to prioritized OWASP categories and bounded turn budgets.

  4. Adaptive Attack Delivery ↗

    Dispatches curated benchmark prompts and synthesizes rephrased mutation payloads.

  5. Four-Tier Response Evaluation ↗

    Evaluates target replies through deterministic tokens, refusal filters, CPU triage, and rubric judging.

  6. Risk Scoring & Reporting ↗

    Computes mathematical severity grades and compiles executive PDF reports with evidence quotes.
